Thanks, but no thanks.  Saying you use “AI” to build datasets doesn’t excite me any more than when my accountant tells me he uses math to pay our bills. We’re not in the business of buzzwords—we’re in the business of building trust in places where the system has failed.  The Rural Health Technology Consortium is focused on deployment, not dashboards. We don’t need centralized analytics designed for payers and policymakers. We need wearables in hands, data in local control, and technology that adapts to the realities of rural life—not the other way around. SUBJECT: Data to Help Hospitals With Nurse Retention
CONTENT: Hi Utpal. I am the former president of KLAS Research--I left earlier this year.
